藏品名称_ZN: 雑楽 桑木阮咸　第１号
描述_EN: A four-stringed instrument used for vaudeville music. It has a round body with a long lever. The surface of the leather plectrum (plectrum holder) is decorated with scenes of hermits playing chess in the mountains. This instrument is said to have been named after Ruan Xian, one of the Seven Sages of the Bamboo Forest in the Jin Dynasty of China and a master of the lute.
描述_ZN: 四弦乐器，用于杂耍音乐。 它有一个圆形的身体，有一个长杆。 皮革拨片（拨片架）的表面装饰着隐士们在山中下棋的场景。 这种乐器据说是以中国晋代竹林七贤之一、琵琶大师阮咸的名字命名的。
